name: LLMS.txt AI Generator
author: pianoweb

sections.description:
LLMS.txt AI Generator is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically creates and manages LLMS.txt files for your website. LLMS.txt files are essential for AI crawlers and search engines to better understand your site’s content structure.

Key Features:

  • AI-Powered Descriptions: Generate intelligent, SEO-optimized descriptions using Google Gemini 2.0 Flash via OpenRouter API
  • 48+ Languages Support: Create content in 48 different languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, and many more
  • Flexible Content Selection: Choose between automatic or manual selection for pages, posts, and custom post types
  • Batch Processing: Handle large websites efficiently with intelligent batch processing to avoid timeouts
  • Real-time Preview: Preview your LLMS.txt file before generation
  • Custom Documents: Include additional documents and files in your LLMS.txt
  • SEO Optimization: Automatically generate meta descriptions and site details
  • Easy Configuration: User-friendly admin interface with comprehensive options

Supported Languages:
Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Burmese, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Gujarati, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malayalam, Marathi, Norwegian, Odia, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, and more.

Perfect for:
* SEO professionals
* Content managers
* Website owners
* Digital agencies
* AI-optimized websites

Credits:
Developed with support from PianoWeb.eu – Web Development & Digital Solutions.

External services

This plugin connects to OpenRouter AI service to generate intelligent descriptions for your website content. This service is used only when the AI description feature is enabled and provides enhanced SEO-optimized content descriptions.

What the service is and what it is used for:
OpenRouter AI (https://openrouter.ai) provides access to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash model for generating intelligent, contextual descriptions of your website’s pages, posts, and content. This enhances your LLMS.txt file with AI-powered descriptions that improve SEO and content understanding for AI crawlers.

What data is sent and when:
– Content titles, excerpts, and text content from your selected pages and posts
– Website URL and basic site information
– Selected language preference
– Data is sent only when you manually trigger the “Generate LLMS.txt” function with AI descriptions enabled
– No personal user data, passwords, or sensitive information is transmitted
– Only public content that would be visible to search engines is processed

Service links:
– OpenRouter Terms of Service: https://openrouter.ai/terms
– OpenRouter Privacy Policy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
– Google AI Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
– Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Important notes:
– This service is completely optional – the plugin works fully without AI features
– You maintain full control over when data is sent (only during manual generation)
– An API key is required to use this service (obtained separately from OpenRouter)
– API usage may incur costs based on OpenRouter’s pricing

Additional Info

API Usage:
This plugin uses the OpenRouter API (https://openrouter.ai) to access Google Gemini 2.0 Flash for AI description generation. API usage is optional and requires a separate API key. Please review OpenRouter’s terms of service and privacy policy.

Privacy:
When AI features are enabled, content from your website may be sent to OpenRouter/Google Gemini for processing. No personal data is transmitted, only public content for description generation.

Support:
For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the plugin’s support forum or contact the developer.

Contributing:
This plugin is open source. Contributions, translations, and feedback are welcome.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/llms-txt-ai-generator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘LLMS.txt Generator’ in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your settings:
    • Enable AI descriptions (optional)
    • Add your OpenRouter API key if using AI features
    • Select your content language
    • Choose which content to include
  5. Click ‘Generate LLMS.txt’ to create your file.
  6. Your LLMS.txt file will be available at yoursite.com/llms.txt
sections.faq:
What is LLMS.txt?

LLMS.txt is a file format that helps AI crawlers and search engines understand your website’s content structure. It provides organized information about your pages, posts, and other content.

Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

No, the plugin works without an API key. However, to use AI-powered description generation, you’ll need an OpenRouter API key which provides access to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash model.

How do I get an OpenRouter API key?

Visit https://openrouter.ai/keys to create an account and generate your API key. OpenRouter provides access to various AI models including Google Gemini.

Can I customize which content is included?

Yes! You can choose between automatic selection (based on criteria like publication status and date) or manual selection where you pick specific pages and posts.

What languages are supported for AI descriptions?

The plugin supports 48+ languages including all major world languages. AI descriptions will be generated in your selected language.

Will this work with custom post types?

Yes, the plugin automatically detects and supports all public custom post types on your website.

Can I preview the LLMS.txt before generating it?

Yes, use the ‘Preview’ button to see exactly how your LLMS.txt file will look before generating it.

Is there a limit on content size?

The plugin includes intelligent batch processing to handle large websites efficiently, avoiding server timeouts.
